name: arden
description: Arden is an open-source AI workspace for real work.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @arden/protocol && npm run build --workspace @arden/connectors && npm run build --workspace @arden/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @arden/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspace @arden/connectors && npm run typecheck --workspace @arden/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @arden/connectors && npm run test --workspace @arden/desktop
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run tauri:check
